brief:
Israeli forces killed Gaza's deputy education minister and his wife in a fresh attack on the territory, according to Middle East Eye. The strike marks the latest in a series of operations targeting Hamas officials in Gaza.

Gaza's health ministry characterized the succession of attacks on Hamas officials as "systematic targeting of all pillars of life" in the enclave. The assault comes amid ongoing military operations in the region.
